description: Opens a three.js, React Three Fiber or WebGL page (a game, viewer, configurator, simulation or shader demo) in a headless Chrome on a paused, seeded clock, closing any page already open, and lists the files it loaded and any that failed. Open once: after an edit, the next game_act, game_look, game_observe, game_eval, game_clock or game_feel reloads the page by itself. Call it after writing or changing such a page, before saying it is done. Give a file or folder to serve (`url`, relative to cwd), an http URL, or a dev-server `command` run in cwd. When cwd holds a game contract, the result ends with its first check.

cwd.description: The game project's folder (where game-contract.json lives).

size.description: The page's width and height in CSS pixels until the next open, 1280 × 800 by default: [390, 844] for a phone held upright, [1920, 1080] for a large screen.

name: game_open
